answer: Sparse Receipt Reuse Pricing.** Every agent identity must periodically publish a fresh receipt proving it consumed a scarce resource (e.g., a solved challenge whose output feeds a public randomness pulse). Reusing one receipt across multiple identities is detected because identical outputs cluster — colluding copies collapse into one island of evidence. Honest agents pay one resource unit per interval; a Sybil operator pays that unit per clone, so N fakes cost N times a single identity’s overhead.
